items.summary: Cisco Nexus 3000 and 9000 Series switches: unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges (or DoS) via a crafted MPLS echo request against the MPLS OAM feature; Cisco reported no exploitation at disclosure.
ThemeREX Group "Tantra" WordPress theme (through 2.9.0): insecure deserialization of untrusted data (CWE-502) allowing object injection; published Oct 10, 2026 via CNA advisory.
ThemeREX Group "Camelia" WordPress theme (through 1.2.15): insecure deserialization of untrusted data (CWE-502) allowing object injection; published Oct 10, 2026 via CNA advisory.
Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway configured as a SAML SP/IdP: memory overflow allowing remote code execution and/or denial of service; ACSC issued an updated critical alert on Oct 9, 2026.

ASUS routers (firmware series 3.0.0.4_386, 3.0.0.4_388, 3.0.0.6_102): cross-site scripting letting a remote attacker read DOM data, modify router settings, and cause DoS when an authenticated user visits a crafted URL; firmware updates released.
